result.summary: The main visual defect is the broken image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section for Tokumaru Ramen Bar.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a large gray image placeholder with a broken/missing image icon instead of the restaurant's actual photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image loading so the restaurant photo renders; if the image is unavailable, display a proper branded placeholder rather than a broken-image glyph.
